B_free_whole_heart.action: Re-specify endpoint 1 on the free 'total' structures
B_free_whole_heart.keeps: 5 structures, so multiplicity correction unchanged; fully open weights, better for reproducibility
B_free_whole_heart.costs: whole-heart volume instead of per-chamber; the reconstruction-sensitivity question is arguably BETTER served by thin structures (vessels) which are more sensitive to slice thickness

recommendation: Ask the user. Option A preserves the pre-specification verbatim; option B is more reproducible and needs no third party. Either way it is a prespec amendment that must be dated and versioned before any segmentation runs.

execution_findings.issue: `--ml` makes `-o` a FILE path, not a directory
execution_findings.evidence: TotalSegmentator.py help text: '-o ... Or path of multilabel output nifti file if --ml option is used.'
execution_findings.symptom: process exits 0, tmp_seg never created, FileNotFoundError on every series

execution_findings.issue: Border-touching structures are silently reported as volume 0.0
execution_findings.evidence: statistics.py: `if touches_border(data) and exclude_masks_at_border:` sets volume 0.0; the flag defaults to True
execution_findings.why_critical: Thoracic staging CT routinely clips the great vessels at the scan boundary. Four of the five pre-specified structures are vessels. Left at the default, an unknown fraction of the cohort would record aorta/SVC/IVC volume 0.0 -- indistinguishable from a genuine measurement of zero and silently biasing the reconstruction comparison, since the two reconstructions of a pair can have different z-coverage.
execution_findings.fix: -sii (--stats_include_incomplete) forces volumes to be computed for border-touching structures
execution_findings.prespec_consequence: Volumes for border-truncated structures are partial-field measurements. Because both members of a pair come from the SAME acquisition they share z-coverage, so the paired comparison remains valid; but absolute volumes are not anatomical totals and must not be reported as such.

execution_findings.issue: Volumes were being recomputed by hand from the mask
execution_findings.fix: switched to the tool's own `-s -sx` statistics.json (volume mm3, n_voxels, intensity, centroid, bbox); `-ss` skips writing masks entirely -> faster and less disk
